product_overview: Arkelythex MVP provides a manual commercial flow that guides interested visitors from pricing information into a demo or pilot request. The experience is designed to capture qualified leads without requiring online checkout.
core_goals: Move from pricing interest to a demo or pilot request
Submit a demo request with required contact and consent details
Capture newsletter interest with explicit consent

features.name: Manual MVP pricing flow
features.description: Visitors can review pilot-oriented pricing and choose to continue into a demo request or contact the team directly through WhatsApp instead of using card checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /precios -> Review plan cards and manual payment notice -> Choose to request a pilot -> Navigate to /demo -> See the demo request form
Navigate to /precios -> Review plan cards and manual payment notice -> Choose WhatsApp contact -> Open direct chat

features.name: Demo request form
features.description: Visitors can submit a public pilot request with their contact details, plan interest, message, and privacy consent.
user_flows: Navigate to /demo -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in company -> Fill in WhatsApp -> Select plan interest -> Fill in message -> Check privacy consent -> Submit pilot request form -> See success state

Navigate to /demo -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in company -> Fill in WhatsApp -> Select plan interest -> Fill in message -> Submit pilot request form without privacy consent -> See validation error state

features.name: Newsletter consent capture
features.description: Visitors can subscribe to the newsletter by providing an email address and explicit newsletter consent.
user_flows: Navigate to /demo -> Fill newsletter email -> Check newsletter consent -> Submit newsletter form -> See success state
Navigate to /demo -> Fill newsletter email -> Submit newsletter form without newsletter consent -> See validation error state

routes.description: Pricing page for manual MVP pilot requests.
Demo request page with WhatsApp CTA and lead capture form.
Newsletter lead capture endpoint with consent validation and Resend notification.
Demo/pilot request endpoint with consent validation and Resend notification.

features.name: Manual MVP pricing flow
features.description: Pricing CTAs route prospects toward pilot/demo requests instead of card checkout.
user_interactions: Review plan cards and manual payment notice
Click Solicitar piloto to navigate to demo request flow
Click WhatsApp CTA for direct chat

features.name: Demo request form
features.description: Public form captures name, email, company, WhatsApp, plan interest, message, and privacy consent.

features.name: Newsletter consent capture
features.description: Footer newsletter form requires explicit newsletter consent before lead notification.

known_limitations.issue: Payment is intentionally manual during MVP; there is no card checkout or payment session.
known_limitations.impact: Test plans must not expect Stripe, PayPal, Culqi, or Mercado Pago checkout yet.

known_limitations.issue: Resend test mode can only deliver to the authorized account email until a sending domain is verified.
known_limitations.impact: Production email delivery to company inbox requires Resend domain verification.
